Khamoshi sach ko aane deti.
Khamoshi woh space hai jahan healing hoti.
Courage—fear ko ek minute aur pakad ke rakhna.
Har us anubhav se jo tum dar ka saamna karte ho, tumhe taakat, sahas aur atma-vishwas milta hai.
Himmat sword nikali hui mohabbat hai.
Grit luck nahi; kaam hai.
Chup rehna sahmati dikhata hai.
Grit woh hai jo tum quit karne ke baad karte.
Silence reminder hai: breathe kar.
Himmat unchi hai.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Jo humare peeche hai aur jo aage hai, woh humare andar jo hai uske samne bahut chhota hai.
Khamosh dimag jhelte hain.
Khamoshi us cheez ka izzat hai jo na boli gayi.
Khamoshi soch ko tez karti.
Grit wahi lagan hai jab duniya kehti hai ruk jao, tab bhi aage badhte rehna.
Strength jeet se nahi aati—struggles tumhari strength banate.
